Description.Name: Everything is Ready
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius strides onto the bridge with a datapad in hand, looking pleased with himself.</color> "Commander, got something for you. Called in a few favors, checked around with contacts groundside. Found ourselves a construction outfit that's actually worked shipyard contracts before, not just planetside warehouses."

"Ashford Yards. Small outfit, but they know their business." <color=#BFBFBF>He hands the datapad over.</color> "Foreman already sent over a formal estimate."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah takes the datapad, scanning through it.</color> "Reasonable staffing plan. A dozen certified riggers and fabricators, materials handling included on their end." <color=#BFBFBF>She pauses on the total.</color> "Cost comes to just over fifty million C-bills for their work alone, then add other costs and we might be looking towards sixty."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire lets out a low whistle.</color> "That's quite the number."

"And it is not fast." <color=#BFBFBF>Farah continues.</color> "Their timeline has the work running past a hundred days from the day they start. Structural work first, then the electronics fit, then final inspection before it is fit to berth a Mech."

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius crosses his arms.</color> "Not cheap, not quick. But considering what that hangar's worth once it's done, still seems like the best offer we're going to find out here."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire speaks up with a questioning voice.</color> "Almost sixty million and over a hundred days of workers underfoot. Worth asking if this ship can even absorb that kind of expense right now."

<color=#BFBFBF>You weigh it over, the estimate glowing steady on the datapad. It is a long commitment and a lot of C-bills. But the hangar is sitting there half-built regardless, waiting on someone to finish the job.</color>

Description.Name: Contract Signed
Description.Details: You sign off on the contract, and Darius wastes no time relaying the confirmation groundside. "Consider it done, Commander. I'll have their advance crew scheduled to meet us." Farah closes out the estimate file. "I will keep an eye on their progress reports once work begins." Yang grins. "Guess we're actually doing this. About time that hole got some use." [The Argo upgrade Mech Hangar 2 has been unlocked. Visit the Engineering view for more details.]
